IGSharp_FontAtlas_AddFontFromMemoryCompr.design: FontAtlas decodes and validates the compressed stream in managed code, including input/output bounds and checksum, then uses the copying font loader. The upstream decompressor ignores input bounds.

IGSharp_FontAtlas_SetFontLoader.design: Native C++ font-loader/plugin interface, not a stable managed delegate ABI. Use the bundled loader; configuring a native loader remains native-host work.
